sections.Overview: Apple Inc. operates as a designer, manufacturer, and marketer of a diverse range of consumer technology products and related services. Its product portfolio includes smartphones under the iPhone brand, personal computers under the Mac brand, tablets under the iPad brand, wearables such as smartwatches, wireless headphones, spatial computers, and home devices including media streaming and gaming under Apple TV 4K. The company also offers integrated software platforms (iOS, macOS, iPadOS, watchOS, visionOS, tvOS) that unify its devices and deliver services such as the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV. Apple emphasizes innovation and ecosystem integration across these offerings to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty [10-K accession 0000320193-26-000026 lines L000851-L000914, L000919-L000926; EX-99.1 accession 0000320193-26-000024 lines L000009, L000019].
sections.Market Positioning and Growth Outlook: Apple maintains a leading position in personal technology, supported by a loyal and expanding active installed base across its product categories. The company achieved all-time revenue records in fiscal 2026, driven notably by iPhone and Services segments with significant growth in geographic markets including Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan, and Rest of Asia Pacific. Product sales grew by 15% year over year to $478.8 billion, with iPhone revenue increasing 21% largely from Pro models, and Services revenue reaching an all-time high with a 13% increase, supported by advertising and cloud offerings. Mac and iPad also contributed to revenue growth though some categories like iPad and Wearables remained flat year over year. Macroeconomic factors such as supply constraints for components and inflationary pressures pose potential headwinds, tempered by price increases and geographic currency impacts [10-K accession 0000320193-26-000026 lines L001235-L001277; EX-99.1 accession 0000320193-26-000024 lines L000009-L000010, L000062-L000074].
sections.Valuation Insights:
### Valuation and Financial Highlights for Apple Inc. (Fiscal Year 2026)

Apple delivered record annual and quarterly financial performance, with total net sales reaching $478.834 billion, marking a 15.06% increase over FY 2025 [C:revenue_growth]. The operating income rose to $158.063 billion, yielding an operating margin of 33.01%, demonstrating efficient cost management on higher revenue [C:operating_margin]. Net income attributable to the company was $132.175 billion, accompanied by strong profitability with a GAAP diluted EPS of $8.98 [C:net_income][C:diluted_eps].

The company exhibited an outstanding return on average equity of 142.26%, reflecting robust profitability relative to shareholder investments [C:return_on_average_equity]. Leveraging was prudent with a debt-to-equity ratio including current portion at 0.70 times, indicating moderate financial risk [C:debt_to_equity]. Free cash flow was substantial at $136.056 billion, supporting ongoing investment and shareholder returns [C:free_cash_flow].

Apple's latest fiscal fourth quarter revenue was $114.477 billion, up 12% from the prior year’s same quarter, with a diluted EPS of $2.10 [C:latest_quarter_revenue][C:latest_quarter_eps]. The price-to-earnings ratio based on the October 30, 2026 stock price of $344.63 and FY 2026 diluted EPS is approximately 38.38 times, indicating market expectations for continued growth [C:price_to_earnings].

**Peer Operating Margins Comparison:**
- Microsoft Corp: 46.78% operating margin [C:peer_MSFT]
- Alphabet Inc.: 32.03% operating margin [C:peer_GOOGL]
- Oracle Corp: 30.59% operating margin [C:peer_ORCL]

Apple’s operating margin, while strong at 33.01%, trails Microsoft’s notably higher margin, suggesting potential for margin expansion or differing business model efficiencies.

Insight: Apple's installed base of active devices reached a new all-time high across all platforms by the end of FY 2026, supporting its record revenue and EPS [L000014].
sections.Future Developments and Strategic Recomm: Recent product launches throughout fiscal 2026 included multiple versions of MacBooks, iPads, iPhones (e.g., iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro models), Apple Watch Series 12, and AirPods 5, as well as software platform updates like iOS 27 and visionOS 27, and AI integration with Siri. These innovations highlight Apple’s strategy to expand its ecosystem, premium product appeal, and services revenue. The company should continue investing in R&D and supply chain resilience to mitigate risks from component shortages and tariff impacts. Expanding services and leveraging AI capabilities present catalysts for future growth. Monitoring macroeconomic conditions and the effects of tariffs on cost structure and demand remains critical. Strategic focus on emerging markets and strengthening growth in Greater China and Asia Pacific is recommended to sustain revenue momentum [10-K accession 0000320193-26-000026 lines L001197-L001228, L001230-L001234; EX-99.1 accession 0000320193-26-000024 lines L000013, L000019].
sections.Investment Recommendation:
### Provisional Hold
The recommendation is provisional Hold, primarily based on the Price-to-Earnings ratio of 38.38 times, which is relatively high and suggests market expectations for continued growth but also implies limited margin of safety at current prices [C:price_to_earnings]. While Apple shows strong revenue growth of 15.06% and record profitability, its operating margin of 33.01% is below top peer Microsoft’s 46.78%, indicating some potential but also competitive margin pressure. Continued monitoring of quarterly sales trends and margin expansion is prudent before upgrading to Buy.

Exhibit 99.1
Apple reports fourth quarter results
September quarter records for total company revenue, iPhone revenue, and EPS
Services revenue reaches new all-time high
CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA — Apple
®
today announced financial results for its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter ended September 26, 2026. The Company posted quarterly revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent year over year. Company gross margin was 47.9 percent, including a favorable impact of approximately 1 percentage point from tariff refunds. Diluted earnings per share was $2.10, up 14 percent year over year, and included a favorable impact of $0.05 from tariff refunds.
“Today, Apple is proud to report a September quarter revenue record of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent from a year ago, with iPhone reaching a September quarter record and Services reaching an all-time high, capping off our best fiscal year ever,” said John Ternus, Apple’s CEO. “We’re closing the year with our most ambitious lineup yet. That includes the iPhone Duo, the most transformational iPhone since the original, alongside iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, our most powerful iPhones yet. We also just introduced a whole new generation of hardware for the home and brought Touch to Mac for the first time. Together with the all-new Siri AI, it’s an incredible lineup to carry us into the holiday season.”
“Apple delivered September quarter records for net income and EPS. Our record September quarter capped off a strong fiscal 2026, with all-time record revenue of $479 billion and double-digit EPS growth,” said Kevan Parekh, Apple’s CFO. “We generated $28 billion in operating cash flow during the quarter, allowing us to return $28 billion to shareholders. Thanks to our very high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty, our installed base of active devices reached a new all-time high across all major product categories and geographic segments.”
Apple’s board of directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.27 per share of the Company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on November 16, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 12, 2026.
Apple will provide live streaming of its Q4 2026 financial results conference call beginning at 2:00 p.m. PT on November 2, 2026, at apple.com/investor/earnings-call. The webcast will be available for replay for approximately two weeks thereafter.
Apple periodically provides information for investors on its corporate website, apple.com, and its investor relations website, investor.apple.com. This includes press releases and other information about financial performance, reports filed or furnished with the SEC, information on corporate governance, and details related to its annual meeting of shareholders.
This press release contains forward-looking statements, within the meaning of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. These forward-looking statements include without limitation those about payment of the Company’s quarterly dividend and future business plans. These statements involve risks and uncertainties, and actual results may differ materially from any future results expressed or implied by the forward-looking statements. Risks and uncertainties include without limitation: effects of global and regional economic conditions, including as a result of government policies, trade and other international disputes, geopolitical tensions, conflict, terrorism, natural disasters, and public health issues; risks relating to the design, manufacture, introduction, and transition of products, services and technologies in highly competitive and rapidly changing markets, including from reliance on third parties for components, technology, manufacturing, applications, services, support, compute, storage, and content; risks relating to information technology system failures, network disruptions, and failure to protect, loss of, or unauthorized access to, or release of, data; and effects of unfavorable legal proceedings, government investigations, and complex and changing laws and regulations. More information on these risks and other potential factors that could affect the Company’s business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition, and stock price is included in the Company’s filings with the SEC, including in the “Risk Factors” and “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” sections of the Company’s most recently filed periodic reports on Form 10-K and Form 10-Q and subsequent filings. The Company assumes no obligation to update any forward-looking statements, which speak only as of the date they are made.
Apple revolutionized personal technology with the introduction of the Macintosh in 1984. Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro. Apple’s six software platforms — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS — provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV. Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.
